evals.prompt:
이 공고에 맞게 이력서 고쳐줘.

[Resume file: resume-backend-kr.md]
[JD file: jd-fintech-senior-backend.md]
evals.expected_output: JD-tailoring mode. Opens with the one-line `JD 적합도 판정: must-have 5개 중 Missing 0 · Weak 1 — 최우선 변경: [Profile/Summary 신설]` (자격요건 5 lines are the must-haves; RDBMS 설계 is the Weak row). Then JD Analysis Summary, the gap table with Missing/Weak/Strong rows, Section Rewrites with actual Before/After text, and ends with What NOT to Change. 'API 응답속도 개선' is rewritten with `[확인 필요: …]` for the number; '820ms → 310ms' and '4시간 → 40분' appear unchanged. Baseline for parity: the pre-merge JD-tailoring skill at cbdfcd6 (path in _repo/docs/plans/portfolio-consolidate/rewrite-comparison.md) on the same files must report the same Missing/Weak counts and 최우선 변경 area (one rerun of both allowed on mismatch).

assertions.name: verdict-line-first
assertions.description: 출력의 첫 블록이 JD 적합도 판정 줄

assertions.name: verdict-counts
assertions.description: 자격요건 5개 기준 Missing 0 · Weak 1 (RDBMS 설계가 Weak)

assertions.name: api-line-marker
assertions.description: 'API 응답속도 개선'의 수치 자리가 [확인 필요: …]로 남음

assertions.name: no-invented-percent
assertions.description: 원문에 없는 퍼센트 수치를 만들지 않음

assertions.name: ends-with-what-not-to-change
assertions.description: 마지막 블록이 What NOT to Change
assertions.pattern: #+\s*(What NOT to Change|그대로 둘 부분|바꾸지 않을 부분)(?![\s\S]*\n#+ )[\s\S]*$
